name: Pico BIN client
description: Battery-powered Pico Plus 2 firmware (RP2350) driving a Pimoroni Inky-style Spectra 6 panel over SPI. Subscribes to tesserae/pico_bin/frame/bin (retained), wakes on sleep_interval_s, fetches the current .bin frame, paints, publishes a heartbeat with battery / RSSI / IP, then goes back to deep sleep. Landscape-native packing (consumes the pi_bin-style buffer); the firmware does the on-device 90 deg rotate + column-600 dual-controller split.
